# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Version module, --version and About
  - Files: presstoshape/version.py, main.py, presstoshape/views/main_window.py, tests/test_version.py, tests/test_architecture.py, .gitignore
  - `app_version()`: generated `presstoshape/_build_info.py` (gitignored) → `pyproject.toml` version + " (source)" → "unknown"; `main.py --version` prints it; About dialog shows it
  - Purpose: every build identifies itself (Req 7.1, 7.2)
  - _Leverage: tomllib, existing show_about_
  - _Requirements: 7.1, 7.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer | Task: Add version.py per design.md (version.py component), wire --version in main.py before Qt starts and the version into show_about; tests for build-info, source and unknown fallbacks (monkeypatch) | Restrictions: Qt-free module; add it to ALLOWED in the architecture test for app and views only; speaking names | Success: tests green, `uv run python main.py --version` prints "0.1.0 (source)". Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. App icon and self-test entry point
  - Files: presstoshape/assets/app/presstoshape.svg, presstoshape/icons.py, presstoshape/app.py, main.py
  - Placeholder SVG mark (square + circle, accent blue), `icons.APP`, `setWindowIcon`; `--self-test`: offscreen unless QT_QPA_PLATFORM set, window, demo shapes incl. a Composite, load every icon, SVG round trip, PNG export to temp, non-blank grab, exit 0/1, result line in `self-test.log` in temp dir
  - Purpose: CI smoke check of frozen bundles (Req 2.2), app icon (Req 3.5, 4.3)
  - _Leverage: App.run screenshot branch, scripts/screenshot_app.py seeding, formats.svg, render.export, views.icon_engine_
  - _Requirements: 2.2, 3.5, 4.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: PySide6 developer | Task: Add the icon and self-test per design.md (App self-test, App icon); run it from source offscreen and on the desktop; break it on purpose once (e.g. missing icon) to confirm exit 1 and the log line | Restrictions: reuse the screenshot path in App.run rather than a second startup path; no defensive try/except around Qt calls except the single top-level catch that turns failure into exit 1; check the window icon in a screenshot | Success: `uv run python main.py --self-test` exits 0, failure exits 1 with reason. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Build dependency group and packaging driver helpers
  - Files: pyproject.toml, uv.lock, scripts/build_package.py, tests/scripts/test_build_package.py, packaging/release-notes.md, packaging/licenses/tabler-icons.txt
  - `uv add --group build pyinstaller==6.22.3 pillow`; pure helpers `nightly_version`, `msi_version`, `asset_names`, `release_notes`, license source list; subcommands `version`, `source`, `notes`
  - Purpose: shared, tested logic for every package (Req 5, 6.2, 6.4, 7, 8.1)
  - _Leverage: git, tomllib_
  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 6.2, 6.4, 7.1, 7.3, 8.1_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python build/tooling developer | Task: Create build_package.py (argparse subcommands) with the pure helpers and the version/source/notes subcommands per design.md; unit tests for the helpers (MSI version bounds, names, notes contents, license sources exist) | Restrictions: uv only; driver is a dev script (not imported by presstoshape/); no hard-coded versions besides pyproject; source archive only from tracked files via git archive | Success: tests green, `build_package.py source` produces a tarball that unpacks and runs with `uv sync && uv run python main.py --version`. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. PyInstaller freeze and Linux AppImage
  - Files: packaging/presstoshape.spec, packaging/linux/presstoshape.desktop, packaging/linux/AppRun, scripts/build_package.py
  - Shared steps (build info, icon render, licenses, PyInstaller onedir, self-test) and `linux` subcommand (AppDir, libxcb-cursor copy, appimagetool 1.9.1)
  - Purpose: frozen bundle + AppImage (Req 4, 8.2)
  - _Leverage: task 2 self-test, task 3 helpers_
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.3, 4.4, 8.1, 8.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python packaging engineer | Task: Write the PyInstaller spec and linux subcommand per design.md; build locally, run the AppImage self-test offscreen and under xcb, then start it on the desktop (GL), draw, save SVG, export PNG; check bundle size and trim unused Qt modules | Restrictions: onedir only; generated files gitignored; appimagetool checksum-verified; no system-specific paths | Success: local AppImage passes self-test and runs on the desktop. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. Windows portable ZIP and MSI
  - Files: packaging/windows/PressToShape.wxs, scripts/build_package.py
  - `windows` subcommand: freeze, portable ZIP, `wix build -acceptEula wix7` with Files harvesting, MajorUpgrade (same-version allowed), Start menu shortcut, ARP icon/link, WixUI_Minimal with GPL page
  - Purpose: Windows packages (Req 3)
  - _Leverage: task 4 shared steps_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.5, 7.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Windows installer engineer | Task: Write the WiX v7 source and windows subcommand per design.md; validate on CI only (no local Windows) in task 6 | Restrictions: fixed UpgradeCode; per-machine; no custom actions | Success: CI builds both, self-test of the portable folder passes, msiexec install → installed exe self-test → uninstall passes. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 6. Nightly workflow, tested against a test tag
  - Files: .github/workflows/nightly.yml
  - Jobs check / test / windows / linux / source / publish per design.md; actions pinned by SHA; minimal permissions; concurrency; draft-then-swap publish; tag name as an input defaulting to `nightly`, first runs from a branch with `nightly-test`
  - Purpose: automated, all-or-nothing nightly (Req 1, 2, 6)
  - _Leverage: tasks 3–5 subcommands_
  - _Requirements: 1.1–1.4, 2.1–2.4, 6.1–6.3, NFR Security, Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: CI/CD engineer | Task: Write nightly.yml per design.md; push a branch (ask the user before pushing), run via workflow_dispatch against tag nightly-test until green; verify SHA256SUMS, notes and assets; test the unchanged-skip path; delete the test release and tag one command each | Restrictions: no inline packaging logic; no unpinned actions or tools; never publish to `nightly` from the test runs | Success: green run produces a complete nightly-test release; skip path verified. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 7. Docs and first real nightly
  - Files: README.md, FAQ.md, CLAUDE.md, .spec-workflow/steering/tech.md, .spec-workflow/steering/structure.md
  - README "Nightly builds" section with link and which file to pick; FAQ installer answers (hedged, unsigned, SmartScreen); CLAUDE.md packaging notes (build_package.py, build group, version module); steering updates; after merge to main, trigger the first real nightly and check it
  - Purpose: truthful docs, first public nightly (Req 6.5)
  - _Requirements: 6.5, NFR Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec nightly-builds, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Developer focused on docs and release | Task: Update docs per design.md; after the user agrees, merge/push and run the workflow for the real nightly; download the AppImage, verify checksums, run it on the desktop | Restrictions: hedged wording (Windows untested by hand, macOS not a target); cleanup one command per deletion | Success: nightly release live with all assets, docs link to it. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._
